description: This file defines an abstract class 'LeaveStatusChange' that represents an event triggered upon a change in leave status within the OrangeHRM system. It contains properties for related leave records, the workflow state machine, and the user performing the action, along with respective getters and a constructor.

classes.name: LeaveStatusChange
classes.description: An abstract event class that encapsulates details about a leave status change, including affected leaves, workflow, and performer.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the event with leaves, workflow, and performer information.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Returns the list of leave entities related to this event.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Returns the workflow state machine associated with this event.

methods.name: getPerformer
methods.description: Returns the user who performed the leave status change.
